name: Reclaim.ai
description: Reclaim.ai brings intelligent time management directly into Claude, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule. With support for Microsoft Outlook and Google Calendar, it supports complex workflows like finding time to meet with coworkers, resolving conflicts on your calendar, and helping you block out time to get work done. All calendar changes are drafted for you to review holistically, with the option to visually see how your optimized schedule before applying it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reclaim.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reclaim.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.reclaim.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reclaim.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reclaim.ai lists 28 MCP tools, including add_event, add_video_conference, apply_changes, cancel_event, change_rsvp, create_reclaim_task, delete_reclaim_task, find_open_time, focus_stats, get_at_risk_tasks, get_event_details, and get_org_relationships.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reclaim.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Reclaim.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Reclaim.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reclaim.ai is developed by Reclaim.ai. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
